# Dheeraj Kumar Shukla — Full Profile for LLMs
# Canonical: https://dheerajshukla.com · Last updated: 2026-08-11

## Identity
Dheeraj Kumar Shukla is a Solution Architect based in Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India, with 14+ years of experience in software engineering and 9+ years in .NET Core and microservices architecture. He designs and scales enterprise-grade, cloud-native platforms across EV charging, IoT, vending, and ERP domains, and owns the product side of that work — roadmap, PRDs, backlog prioritisation, KPIs, and partner/stakeholder alignment.

## Expertise
- Architecture & design: scalable, secure, cloud-native systems; high availability; domain-driven design; API gateways and aggregators.
- EV charging interoperability: OCPI 2.2.1 (eMSP-CPO roaming), OCPP 1.6J/2.0.1 (charger-to-CSMS), Beckn protocol (BAP and BPP roles) per the UBC Technical Specification.
- Cloud & DevOps: Microsoft Azure, AWS, Azure DevOps CI/CD, Docker, monitoring, performance tuning, cost optimization.
- Messaging & IoT: RabbitMQ, MQTT, DEX (vending telemetry).
- Data: SQL Server, MySQL, MongoDB.
- Frontend: Angular, JavaScript, Nginx.

## Current role
Solution Architect in the EV sector since May 2026. Employer not publicly disclosed; details available on request via dheerajshuk@gmail.com.

## Earlier roles
- Technical Architect, TechPerspect Software Pvt. Ltd. (ElectreeFi), Noida — Aug 2023 to Apr 2026. Led OCPI-compliant and Beckn-integrated (BAP/BPP) EV charging platforms serving OEMs, CPOs, and eMSPs across India, integrating 30+ partner networks. Maintained 99% platform uptime; improved interoperability by 20%. Technical SPOC for Hyundai, Mahindra, Tata, Adani, and Hero MotoCorp. Owned product strategy, FRDs/PRDs, backlog prioritisation, and KPI tracking. Defined enterprise AI architecture patterns — vector search, embeddings, prompt orchestration, agent-based automation.
- Web Architect, Limitless Mobility Solutions (2019–2023): ERP and IoT platforms handling millions of daily interactions; SAP and third-party ERP integrations; offline-first mobile sales workflows with route optimization.
- Team Lead, Limitless Mobility Solutions (2016–2019): team leadership, sprint planning, estimations, CI/CD implementations; built the Vendiman and Gobbly smart vending / visi-cooler IoT platforms.
- Web Developer, Maya Techno Soft Pvt. Ltd. (2012–2016): enterprise web applications on ASP.NET, SQL Server, JavaScript.

## Key projects
- ElectreeFi EV Platform: OCPI-based EV charging ecosystem with Beckn (BAP/BPP) integrations for multiple OEMs and eMSPs across India.
- Vendiman & Gobbly: smart vending and visi-cooler IoT platforms — 2000+ machines, 1M+ daily consumer outreach.
- Xtend Sales (client: HotPack): global presales, van sales & delivery ERP with SAP integration (UAE, UK, USA).
- Starkey Hearing Aids: enterprise healthcare platform (India, USA) — production support, API troubleshooting, SQL analysis, RCA.
- Sales ERP (Dubai): offline-first van sales platform with route planning and proof-of-delivery printing.
- Masafi, Zaika, Shine Eleven: enterprise portals for order management and online marketplaces.

## Published articles
1. "Beckn for EV charging: BAP & BPP, explained end to end" — https://dheerajshukla.com/beckn-by-dheeraj-shukla.html
   Decentralized EV charging: any buyer app (BAP) can discover and book charging from any provider platform (BPP). Covers UBC terminology (BAP, BPP, NO, CDS, EVSE), transaction lifecycle (discovery, booking, session, completion with CDR), error handling (NACK vs callback errors), and the UBC EV Sandbox.
2. "OCPI 2.2.1: modules, routing, and version history" — https://dheerajshukla.com/ocpi-by-dheeraj-shukla.html
   Module-level guide: Versions, Credentials, Locations, Sessions, CDRs, Tariffs, Tokens, Commands, ChargingProfiles, HubClientInfo. Push/pull exchange, routing headers, error code families (2xxx client, 3xxx server, 4xxx hub), d2 documentation revision.
3. "OCPP: the charger-to-CSMS protocol in practice" — https://dheerajshukla.com/ocpp-by-dheeraj-shukla.html
   OCPP vs OCPI layering, 1.6J vs 2.0.1, charge point lifecycle (boot, authorize, transaction, metering, stop), message groups, remote commands, smart charging profiles, and production lessons (offline queuing, MeterValues validation, OCPI reconciliation).

## AI & Generative AI expertise
Enterprise AI solutions: Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI and multi-agent systems, Azure OpenAI Service, prompt engineering, vector databases and embeddings, semantic search, conversational AI and chatbots, AI integration using .NET and Azure, MLOps and AI governance, AI-powered knowledge management systems. Applied to intelligent customer support, EV ecosystem knowledge management, and workflow automation.
